type.description: Part discriminant. `text` carries `text`; `image` carries either `url` or (`data`, `mediaType`).

url.description: Image URL; present iff type == "image" and the image is remote.

data.description: Base64 image payload; present iff type == "image" and the image is inline.

mediaType.description: MIME type of the image (e.g. image/png); accompanies `data`, advisory for `url`.
